Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/melting/workflow/subtasks/copper_melting_npt_subtask_melting_trial_3/melting.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for copper melting simulation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read initial structure
read_data initial.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/melting/workflow/subtasks/copper_potential_file_subtask_melting_trial_3/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300.0 4928459 dist gaussian

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute mass_sum all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal c_mass_sum/v_volume/6.02214076e23*1.0e24

# NPT heating
fix npt all npt temp 300.0 2000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Output settings
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density v_density

# Run heating
timestep 1.0
run 20000

# Print final density
print "Final_density: ${v_density}"
"}
